title: 第6章 风雪杀机
content_zh:
秦英豪望着怀里女儿那张甜美秀丽的脸蛋，脑海中浮现起六年前的往事。这件事已经过去六年了，但好像是昨天刚发生一样，一切全清清楚楚。眼前下着倾盆大雨，六年前的那天，下的却是雪，漫山遍野鹅毛般的大雪。

    那是在陕西山阳的鹘岭道路上，时近岁晚，道上行人稀少，秦英豪骑着一匹高头长腿的黄马，控辔北行。十数年前的腊月，他和闵刀王在天竺山大顶峰比武，以毒刀误伤了闵恩仇。闵夫人自刎殉夫。他与闵恩仇武功相当，豪气相投，两人化敌为友，相敬相重，岂知一招之失，竟伤了这位生平唯一知己。他是当世大侠，纵横海内，直到遇上了闵恩仇，才遇上了真正的对手，才真正的肝胆相照。秦英豪为了此事，十二年来始终耿耿于怀，郁郁寡欢。

    闵恩仇夫妇逝世十二年周年将近，秦英豪去年这时曾去祭拜过亡友夫妇之墓，见墓砖有些残破了，拿了些钱叫人修葺。这时左右无事，又千里迢迢从射阳赶来，他要再到亡友夫妇墓前去察看，残破处是否已经修好。风雪残年，马上黄昏，秦英豪越近山阳，心越沉重。他纵马缓行，心中在想：“当年若不是一招失手，今日与闵兄夫妇三骑漫游天下，叫贪官污吏、土豪贼匪，无不心惊胆碎。那是何等快意！”

    正自出神，忽然听到身后车轮压雪，一个司机驾车而行，一辆豪车从白茫茫的雪原上冲风冒雪，疾行而来。大车从秦英豪身旁掠过，忽听一个娇柔的女子声音从车中传了出来：“爸爸，到了维京，你得陪我去各个风景区玩玩儿……”这是江南姑娘极柔极清的语声，在这西北茫茫雪原上，甚不相衬。

    突然，车前轮驶进一个凹槽，顿时向前蹶踬。那司机下车来，托住前厢，随手上提，跟着一跃回到车上，继续驰行。秦英豪暗暗诧异：“司机这一提一跃，好俊的身手，好强的膂力！看来是位风尘奇士，怎么去跑车子了？”

    思算未定，只听脚步声响，后面一个农民工挑了一担行李，迈开大步赶了上来。这担行李压的一根枣木扁担直弯下去，颇为沉重，但那农民工行若无事，在雪地里快步而行，落脚甚轻。秦英豪更加奇怪：“这农民工非但力大，而且轻功了得。”他知道其中必有蹊跷：“这农民工似在追踪前面那车，看来会有凶杀寻仇之事。”当下提着马缰，不疾不徐地遥遥跟在豪车后面，要待看个究竟。

    行出数里，见那农民工虽肩上压着沉重行李，仍奔跑如飞。忽听身后铜片叮叮当当响，一个汉子挑着一副馄饨担子，虚飘飘赶来。这人在雪中行走，落步甚轻，轻功之佳，武林中甚为罕见。秦英豪寻思：“又多了一个。这人是哪一派的？”但见他斗笠和蓑衣上罩满了白雪，在风中一晃一飘，走得歪歪斜斜，顿时想起：“这身轻功是大化所的功夫。”

    行了七八里路，天色黑下来，来到一个小市集。秦英豪见豪车停在一家饭店前面，于是进店借宿。饭店甚小，集上就此一家。客商们都挤在厅上取暖喝酒，司机、农民工、馄饨贩子都在其内。

    秦英豪虽名满天下，但近十年来隐居射阳，武林中认识他的人不多。那司机、农民工、馄饨贩子他都不相识，于是默然坐在一张小桌旁，要了酒饭，见那三人分别喝酒用饭，互不招呼，瞧来似乎并非一路。

    忽听内院一个人大声说：“方主任、方姑娘，小地方委屈点儿，只好在外边厅上用饭。”棉帘掀开，服务员引着一名达官、一位姑娘来到厅上。本来坐着的客商见到达官，纷纷起立。秦英豪并不理会，自顾自喝酒。只见那达官穿着酱色缎面狐皮外套，相貌甚是英俊。那姑娘相貌娇美，肤色白腻，双眼灵动，樱红小嘴，别说西北罕有如此佳丽，即令江南也是少有。她身穿一件葱绿织锦的皮袄，颜色鲜艳，但在她容光映照下，再灿烂的锦缎也显得黯然无色。

    众人眼前一亮，不由都有自惭形秽之感，有的讪讪地竟自退到了廊下，厅上顿时空出一大片地方来。

    服务员一叠连声叫唤，送饭送酒，极为殷勤。秦英豪听他叫喊酒菜时中气充沛，不觉留神，瞧他身形步法，显然是个会家子，又见他两边“太阳穴”微微凸出，竟然内功有颇深造诣，不由更加奇怪，暗想：“这批人必有重大图谋，左右闲着，就瞧瞧热闹，且看他们干的是好事还是歹事。不知跟这官儿有干系没有？”

    这一留神，不免向那达官与姑娘多看了几眼。那达官忽然一拍桌子，发作起来，指着秦英豪骂道：“你是什么东西？见了本官不回避也就罢了，贼眼还骨碌碌地瞧个不休。我看你粗手大脚，生成一副贼相，再瞧一眼，拿片子送到局子里去打你个皮开肉绽。”秦英豪低头喝酒，并不理会。那达官更加怒了，叫道：“你请安赔礼也不会么？这等大剌剌坐着。”

    那姑娘柔声劝说：“爸，你犯得着生这么大气？乡下人不懂规矩，也是有的。何必跟这些粗人一般见识？呐，喝了这杯吧。”说着将一杯酒递到他嘴边。那达官咕嘟一口喝干，似乎将怒气和酒吞服了，横了秦英豪一眼，见他低头不语，想是怕了，于是一边自斟自饮，一边跟女儿随意说笑，话中说的都是到了维京后，补上了官便怎样怎样，瞧神情似是一名赴京谋干的候补官员。

    说话间大门推开，飘进一片风雪，跟着又走进一位官员来。这人生得精瘦，肤色蜡黄，远没先前那官儿的气派十足。他笑着说：“人生何处不相逢，又和崎骏兄在这里撞见，真是巧之极矣！”说着抢过来与那名叫方崎骏的达官行礼相见。

    方家父女一起站起，方崎骏拱手说：“法官侯，幸会幸会！一起坐吧。”那法官侯谢了，坐在桌边。服务员添上杯筷，传酒呼菜。

    秦英豪心想：“连这个法官侯，一共是五个高手了。这姓方的父女看不出有什么武功。会不会大智若愚，竟让我走了眼呢？”想到此处，不禁暗自警戒，不敢向他们多瞧一眼。他一生所历风险多过常人百倍，此刻不由心惊：“这几人说不定是冲着我而来。他们成群结党，一起上来倒是难斗。不知前面是否更有高手？”只听法官侯与方崎骏高谈阔论，说的都是些**中升迁降谪的轶闻。

    廊下农民工和馄饨贩子却突然大声吵嚷起来。两人争的是世上有没有当真削铁如泥的宝剑宝刀。农民工说：“什么削铁如泥，胡吹大气！那宝刀也不过锋利点儿，当真就这么神？”馄饨贩子说：“你见过多少世面了？知道什么？宝刀就是宝刀，若不是怕吓坏了你，我就拿一口让你开开眼界。”农民工吵嚷：“你有宝刀？呸，做你的清秋大梦！有宝刀也不烧馄饨啦！只怕磨不利的钝柴刀、锈菜刀，倒有这么一把两把！”众人都大笑起来。

    馄饨贩子气呼呼地从担儿里取出一把刀来，绿皮鞘子金吞口，模样不凡。他唰地拔刀出鞘，寒光逼人，果然好一口利刃。众人都称赞：“好刀！”馄饨贩子拿起刀来，挥刀作势向农民工砍去。农民工抱头大叫：“我的妈呀！”急忙避开，众人又一阵哄笑。

    秦英豪瞧了二人神情，心想：“这两人果是一路。这么串戏，却不是演给我看的？”

    馄饨贩子说：“有上好菜刀柴刀，请借一把。”服务员应声走入后厨，取了一把菜刀出来。馄饨贩子说：“你拿稳了！”服务员将菜刀高高举起。馄饨贩子横刀挥去，铛的一声，菜刀断为两截，上半截当啷一声落地。众人齐声喝彩：“果是宝刀！”

    馄饨贩子得意洋洋，大声吹嘘，说他这柄刀如何厉害，如何名贵。廊下众人脸现仰慕之色，津津有味地听着。方崎骏听他说了一会，忍不住哼了一声，脸现不屑之色。

    法官侯说：“崎骏兄，这柄刀确也称得上个‘宝’字了，想不到贩夫走卒之徒居然身怀这等利器。”言下甚是可惜。方崎骏说：“利则利矣，宝则未必。”法官侯说：“崎骏兄此言差矣！你瞧此刀削铁如泥，世上哪里更有胜于此刀的呢？”方崎骏说：“你这就未免少见多怪了，方某就……”还待再说下去，方姑娘方玲忽然插口说：“爸，你喝多啦。快吃了饭去睡吧。”

    方崎骏笑着说：“嘿，女孩家就爱管你老子。”说着却真的要饭吃，不再喝酒。法官侯又说：“兄弟今日总算开了眼界，这等宝刀，兄台想来也是生平第一次见到。”方崎骏冷笑说：“胜于此刀十倍的也常常见到。”法官侯哈哈大笑说：“取笑，取笑！兄台是位文官，又见过什么宝刀来？”

    馄饨贩子听到了二人对答，大声说：“世上若有更胜得此刀的宝刀，我宁愿把头割下来送他！吹大气又谁不会啦？嘿，我说我儿子也要去维京做官哩。你们信不信啊？”众人忙喝道：“胡说，快闭嘴！”
content_en:
Qin Yinghao looked at the sweet and beautiful face of his daughter in his arms, and the past six years ago came to mind.Six years have passed since this incident, but it seems like it happened yesterday and everything is clear.It was raining heavily in front of me, but on that day six years ago, it was snowing, and the snow was as heavy as goose feathers all over the mountains and fields.
It was on the Falcon Ridge Road in Shanyang, Shaanxi Province. It was late in the year and there were few pedestrians on the road. Qin Yinghao rode a yellow horse with a tall head and long legs and headed northward.In the twelfth lunar month more than ten years ago, he and King Min Dao were competing at the top of Tianzhu Mountain and accidentally injured Min Enchou with a poisonous knife.Mrs. Min committed suicide by killing her husband.He and Min Enchou were equal in martial arts and had the same heroic spirit. The two of them turned enemies into friends and respected each other. Little did they know that one missed move would actually hurt the only confidant in their lives.He was a great hero of the time, traveling across the sea, and it was not until he met Min Enchou that he met his real opponent and truly showed his sincerity.Because of this matter, Qin Yinghao has been brooding and depressed for twelve years.
The twelfth anniversary of the death of Min Enchou and his wife was approaching. Qin Yinghao went to pay homage to the tomb of his deceased friend and his wife at this time last year. He saw that the tomb bricks were somewhat damaged, so he took some money to have someone repair it.There was nothing going on at this time, and he had come all the way from Sheyang. He wanted to go to the tomb of his deceased friend and his wife to see if the damaged parts had been repaired.It was windy and snowy, and it was dusk. The closer Qin Yinghao got to the mountain sun, the heavier his heart became.He rode his horse slowly, thinking in his mind: "If I hadn't missed a move back then, today I would be roaming around the world with Brother Min and his wife on three horses, calling on corrupt officials, local tyrants and bandits, and everyone would be frightened. How happy it is!"
While I was lost in thought, I suddenly heard a driver driving behind me, and a luxury car came rushing through the wind and snow from the white snowfield.The big car passed by Qin Yinghao, and suddenly a delicate female voice came from the car: "Dad, when we get to Viking, you have to accompany me to various scenic spots to play..." This was the soft and clear voice of a girl from the south of the Yangtze River. It was incompatible with the vast snowy plains in the northwest.
Suddenly, the front wheels of the car drove into a groove and suddenly kicked forward.The driver got out of the car, held the front compartment, lifted it up with his hands, jumped back into the car, and continued driving.Qin Yinghao was secretly surprised: "The driver jumped up and down. He is so handsome and has such strong physical strength! It seems that he is a famous man in the world, why is he driving a car?"
Before I could make up my mind, I heard the sound of footsteps. A migrant worker from behind picked up a load of luggage and strode up to catch up.The jujube wood pole carried by this load of luggage bent straight down and was quite heavy. However, the migrant worker acted as if nothing had happened and walked quickly in the snow, settling very lightly.Qin Yinghao was even more surprised: "This migrant worker is not only very strong, but also very good at lightness." He knew that there must be something fishy: "This migrant worker seems to be following the car in front of him, and it seems that there will be murder and revenge." He picked up the horse's reins and followed the luxury car at a distance, waiting to see what happened.
After walking a few miles, I saw the migrant worker running as fast as he could even though he had heavy luggage on his shoulders.Suddenly, I heard the tinkling of copper pieces behind me, and a man came rushing over carrying a load of wontons.This man walked in the snow, his steps were very light, and his lightness skills were excellent, which was very rare in the martial arts world.Qin Yinghao thought: "There is one more person. Which sect does this person belong to?" But when he saw that his bamboo hat and raincoat were covered with white snow, swaying in the wind, and walking crookedly, he suddenly remembered: "This light kung fu is from the Dahua Institute."
After walking seven or eight miles, it got dark and we came to a small market.Qin Yinghao saw the luxury car parked in front of a hotel, so he went in to stay overnight.The hotel is very small, and this is the only one in the market.The merchants were all crowded in the hall to keep warm and drink. Drivers, migrant workers, and wonton sellers were all among them.
Although Qin Yinghao is famous all over the world, he has lived in seclusion in Sheyang for the past ten years. Not many people in the martial arts know him.He didn't know the driver, the migrant worker, or the wonton seller, so he sat silently at a small table and ordered wine and food. He saw that the three people drank and dined separately without greeting each other. It seemed that they were not in the same group.
Suddenly I heard a person in the inner courtyard say loudly: "Director Fang, Miss Fang, the small place is a bit aggrieved, so we have to eat in the outside hall." The cotton curtain was opened, and the waiter led a dignitary and a girl to the hall.The merchants who were sitting stood up one after another when they saw the official.Qin Yinghao ignored it and drank alone.I saw that the official was wearing a brown satin fox fur coat and he looked very handsome.The girl has a delicate appearance, fair complexion, lively eyes, and a small cherry-red mouth. Not to mention that such beauties are rare in the northwest, even in the south of the Yangtze River.She was wearing a bright green brocade leather jacket, which was brightly colored, but under the light of her face, the bright brocade looked dull and colorless.
Everyone's eyes lit up, and they couldn't help but feel ashamed. Some of them even retreated to the corridor, leaving a large space in the hall suddenly vacant.
The waiters called out one after another, delivering food and wine, and were extremely attentive.Qin Yinghao was full of energy when he heard him shouting about the food and drinks. Looking at his figure and footwork, he was obviously a good man. He also saw that his "temples" on both sides were slightly protruding. He actually had profound internal skills. He couldn't help but be even more surprised. He thought to himself: "This group of people must have a big plot. Just watch the excitement and see if they are doing good or bad things. I wonder if they have anything to do with this official?"
After paying attention, he couldn't help but look at the dignitary and the girl a few more times.The high-ranking official suddenly slammed the table, became angry, pointed at Qin Yinghao and cursed: "Who are you? You just don't avoid me when you see me, and you keep looking at me like a thief. I see that you are rough and thief-like. If I take another look, I will take the film to the bureau and beat you to pieces." Qin Yinghao lowered his head to drink and ignored it.The official became even more angry and shouted: "You can't even ask me to apologize? You are sitting here like this."
The girl persuaded him softly: "Dad, why are you so angry? There are still country people who don't know the rules. Why should you be like these rough people? Now, have a drink." Then she handed a glass of wine to his mouth.The official drank it all in one gulp, seeming to have swallowed up his anger and wine. He glanced at Qin Yinghao and saw that he lowered his head and said nothing. He thought he was afraid, so he poured himself a drink and joked casually with his daughter. He talked about what he would do after arriving in Viking and filling up his official position. He looked like a candidate official who went to Beijing to seek employment.
As he spoke, the door opened, letting in a cloud of wind and snow, and then another official walked in.This man was lean and had a sallow complexion, far less impressive than the previous official.He said with a smile: "We meet everywhere in life, and it is a coincidence that we bump into brother Qi Shun here!" As he said, he rushed over and saluted the high-ranking official named Fang Qi Shuo.
The Fang family's father and daughter stood up together. Fang Qijun raised his hands and said, "Judge, it's a pleasure to meet you! Let's sit together." The judge thanked him and sat at the table.The waiter added cups and chopsticks and passed around drinks and dishes.
Qin Yinghao thought to himself: "Even this judge, there are five masters in total. The father and daughter named Fang don't have any martial arts skills. Could it be that they are so smart that they let me lose my sight?" Thinking of this, he couldn't help but secretly warn, not daring to take another look at them.He has experienced a hundred times more risks in his life than ordinary people. At this moment, he can't help but feel frightened: "These people may be coming for me. They are in groups, and it is difficult to fight together. I wonder if there are more masters ahead?" I only listened to the judge Hou and Fang Qijun talking loudly, telling anecdotes about promotions and demotions in the army.
The migrant workers and wonton sellers on the porch suddenly started making a loud noise.What the two are arguing about is whether there is a sword in the world that can really cut iron like clay.The migrant worker said: "Why are you cutting iron like mud and bragging! The sword is only sharp, is it really that amazing?" The wonton seller said: "How many times have you seen the world? What do you know? A sword is a sword. If I weren't afraid of scaring you, I wouldJust take one and it will open your eyes." The migrant workers shouted: "You have a precious knife?What a dream!I don't want to burn wontons if I have a precious knife!I'm afraid there are only two of them that are hard to sharpen." Everyone laughed!
The wonton seller angrily took out a knife from his carrier. It had a green leather scabbard and a golden mouth. It looked extraordinary.He quickly drew the sword out of its sheath, the cold light was threatening, and it turned out to be a sharp blade.Everyone praised: "What a knife!" The wonton seller picked up the knife and slashed at the migrant workers with the knife.The migrant worker held his head and shouted: "Oh my God!" He hurriedly avoided it, and everyone burst into laughter again.
Qin Yinghao looked at the expressions of the two of them and thought to himself: "These two people are really together. This kind of drama is not just for me?"
The wonton seller said, "I have a good kitchen knife and hatchet. Please lend me one." The waiter walked into the kitchen and took out a kitchen knife.The wonton seller said, "You've got it!" The waiter raised the kitchen knife high.The wonton seller swung his knife horizontally, and with a clang, the kitchen knife broke into two pieces, and the upper half fell to the ground with a clang.Everyone cheered in unison: "It's a treasured sword!"
The wonton seller was very proud and boasted loudly about how powerful and valuable his knife was.Everyone in the corridor had admiration on their faces and listened with interest.Fang Qijun listened to him for a while and couldn't help but snorted, with a look of disdain on his face.
Judge Hou said: "Brother Qi Shun, this sword can indeed be called a 'treasure'. I never thought that a trafficker and a lackey would actually possess such a sharp weapon." It was a pity.Fang Qijun said: "A profit is a benefit, but a treasure is not necessarily a treasure." Judge Hou said: "Brother Qijun, you are wrong! Look at this knife that cuts iron like clay. Where in the world can there be a better knife than this?" Fang Qijun said: "You are so rare and strange, Fang..." Before he could continue, Miss Fang Ling suddenly interrupted and said: "Dad, you drank too much. Hurry up and eat and go to bed."
Fang Qijun said with a smile: "Hey, the girl's family will always care about you." As he said this, he really asked for food and no longer drank.Judge Hou added: "Brother, I finally opened my eyes today. This is the first time in my life that I have seen such a precious sword." Fang Qijun sneered and said, "I often see swords that are ten times better than this." Judge Hou laughed and said, "You are making fun of me! You are a civil servant, what kind of sword have you seen before?"
The wonton seller heard the exchange between the two men and said loudly: "If there is a sword in the world that is better than this sword, I would rather cut off his head and give it to him! Who doesn't know how to blow the air? Hey, I said that my son will also go to the Vikings to become an official. Do you believe it or not?" Everyone shouted: "Nonsense, shut up!"
